notes: Hand-picked from the species the India trip does not hold, for the dry west: the Little Rann and Great Rann of Kutch with the Banni grasslands, Velavadar, Nalsarovar and Thol, Jamnagar and the Gulf of Kutch coast, Gir, Jaisalmer and the Desert National Park, Bikaner, Tal Chhapar and Sambhar Lake. Ranked by birding knowledge plus the GBIF/eBird record counts for the whole country (in/occurrence.csv, which hardly sees these arid and coastal birds). It holds the desert larks (Greater Hoopoe-Lark, Desert, Bimaculated, Tawny and Black-crowned Sparrow-Lark), four wheatears, three sandgrouse, the bustards (Great Indian Bustard, Houbara, Lesser Florican) and Demoiselle Crane, two coursers and two pratincoles, quails, scrub birds (Asian Desert Warbler, Rufous-fronted Prinia, Hypocolius), shrikes, Sind Woodpecker, winter sparrows and buntings, harriers, owls, vultures and small falcons, Lesser Flamingo and the winter waterbirds, the reef-herons, Crab-Plover and Indian Skimmer, and the gulls, terns and waders of the Gujarat coast. The country trip already has Greater and Rufous-tailed Larks, Greater Short-toed Lark, Sand Lark, Isabelline Wheatear, Yellow-wattled Lapwing, Pallid Harrier, Imperial and Steppe Eagle, Common Crane, Greater Flamingo, Great Grey and Bay-backed Shrike and Brown Rock Chat, so they are not repeated. Gir has no extra birds here: its forest birds are in the country trip. Left out for lack of trustworthy photos in the library: Sykes's Warbler, Indian Spotted Eagle, Asian Dowitcher, Sind Sparrow, Eastern Orphean Warbler, White-cheeked Tern, Lesser Crested Tern, Hume's Lark, Grey-necked Bunting, Sykes's Nightjar, Saker Falcon, Indian Bushlark, Singing Bushlark, Large Woodshrike and Tibetan Sand Plover (the first of these were already dropped from the country trip for the same reason). Left out because they do not belong to this region: Painted Bush-Quail (hill forest of the Satpuras and south, for the central or Ghats pack) and Hume's Wheatear (a scarce winter visitor, not realistic for a visitor). Vagrants and expedition birds were left out. Shaky photo picks, to check on /trip-photos: Persian Wheatear, Variable Wheatear (black-headed morphs), Saunders's Tern (Little Tern lookalike), Asian Houbara (race cannot be checked), Rock Bush-Quail (barred birds assumed female), Rain Quail, Pied Harrier (flight shots), Bimaculated Lark, Tawny Lark, Desert Lark (pale birds), Sind Woodpecker (three card photos plus two quiz), Rufous-fronted Prinia (card photos only), Hypocolius, Lesser Kestrel, Pacific Reef-Heron (dark morph quiz photos).
